title: Enforcement.
bodyText: The department of health shall administer and enforce the immunization and tuberculin test requirements under sections 302A-1154 to 302A-1163.
bodyHtml: [§302A-1163]  Enforcement.  The department of health shall administer and enforce the immunization and tuberculin test requirements under sections 302A-1154 to 302A-1163. [L 1996, c 89, pt of §2]
